accessibility.description: TS4 Access adds narration, keyboard navigation, a scanner for Sims and objects, accessible Live Mode menus, travel lists and supported object placement in Build Mode on Windows. Speech uses Windows text-to-speech, or NVDA, JAWS and braille with the optional Speech Pack; Microsoft Narrator and macOS are unsupported. Create a Sim appearance controls, structural building tools and some maps still require a mouse. Install the TS4 Access Helper and enable script mods before playing; game patches may disable mods or require a compatible mod update. No expansion packs are required.
